answer.value: Weights are in Hugging Face Transformers format, compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed. Deployable via SGLang, vLLM, TokenSpeed; also usable via the Qwen Cloud API. Accessed through the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API (OpenAI Python SDK), with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking/preserve_thinking and a reasoning_effort parameter (xhigh default, medium, low). Text-only, thinking mode required; responses begin with reasoning in <think>...</think>.
